segments.en: THE PERILS OF LIBERTY
segments.sw: HATARI ZA UHURU

segments.en: "For ye, brethren, were called for freedom; only use not your freedom for an occasion to the flesh, but through love be servants one to another. For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, even in this; Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. But if ye bite and devour one another, take heed that ye be not consumed one of another."--GAL. v. 13-15.
segments.sw: "Maana ninyi, ndugu, mliitwa mpate uhuru; lakini uhuru wenu usiwe sababu ya kuufuata mwili, bali tumikianeni kwa upendo. Maana torati yote imetimilika katika neno moja, nalo ni hili, Umpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako. Lakini mkiumana na kulana, angalieni msije mkaangamizana."--GAL. v. 13-15.

segments.en: Our analysis has drawn a strong line across the middle of this chapter. At ver. 13 the Apostle turns his mind in the ethical direction. He has dismissed "the troublers" with contempt in ver. 12; and until the close of the Epistle does not mention them again; he addresses his readers on topics in which they are left out of view. But this third, ethical section of the letter is still continuous with its polemical and doctrinal argument.
segments.sw: Uchanganuzi wetu umeweka mpaka dhahiri katikati ya sura hii. Katika mstari wa 13 Mtume anaelekeza mawazo yake kwenye maadili. Katika mstari wa 12 amewaondolea mbali kwa dharau wale "wanaowafadhaisha"; wala hatawataja tena hadi mwisho wa Waraka. Anazungumza na wasomaji wake kuhusu mambo ambayo hayawahusu moja kwa moja watu hao. Lakini sehemu hii ya tatu ya waraka, inayohusu maadili, bado inaendelea na hoja zake za mabishano na za mafundisho ya imani.

segments.en: It applies the maxim of ver. 6, "Faith works through love"; it reminds the Galatians how they had "received the Spirit of God" (ch. iii. 2, 3; iv. 6). The rancours and jealousies opposed to love, the carnal mind that resists the Spirit--these are the objects of Paul's dehortations. The moral disorders which the Apostle seeks to correct arose largely out of the mischief caused by the Judaizers. And his exhortations to love and good works are themselves indirectly polemical. They vindicate Paul's gospel from the charge of antinomianism, while they guard Christians from giving occasion to the charge. They protect from exaggeration and abuse the liberty already defended from legalistic encroachments. The more precious and sacred is the freedom of Gentile believers, the more on the one hand do those deserve punishment who would defraud them of it; and the more earnestly must they on their part guard this treasure from misuse and dishonour. In this sense ver. 13a stands between the sentence against the Circumcisionists in ver. 12 and the appeal to the Galatians that follows. It repeats the proclamation of freedom made in ver. 1, making it the ground at once of the judgement pronounced against the foes of freedom and the admonition addressed to its possessors. "For you were called (summoned by God to enter the kingdom of His Son) with a view to liberty--not to legal bondage; nor, on the other hand, that you might run into licence and give the reins to self-will and appetite--not liberty for an occasion to the flesh."
segments.sw: Sehemu hii inatumia kanuni ya mstari wa 6, "Imani itendayo kazi kwa upendo"; inawakumbusha Wagalatia jinsi walivyompokea "Roho wa Mungu" (sura ya iii. 2, 3; iv. 6). Chuki na wivu unaopingana na upendo, pamoja na nia ya mwili inayompinga Roho, ndivyo Paulo anavyowaonya waache. Matatizo ya kimaadili ambayo Mtume anataka kuyarekebisha yalitokana kwa kiasi kikubwa na madhara yaliyosababishwa na wale waliotaka Wakristo wafuate desturi za Kiyahudi. Na mawaidha yake kuhusu upendo na matendo mema yenyewe ni sehemu ya mabishano yake kwa njia isiyo ya moja kwa moja. Yanaitetea injili ya Paulo dhidi ya shtaka la kupinga sheria (antinomianism), huku yakiwalinda Wakristo wasitoe sababu ya kushtakiwa hivyo. Yanaulinda uhuru ambao tayari umetetewa dhidi ya kuingiliwa na ushikaji wa sheria, ili usipitishwe mipaka wala kutumiwa vibaya. Kadiri uhuru wa waumini wa Mataifa ulivyo wa thamani na mtakatifu, ndivyo kwa upande mmoja wale wanaotaka kuwanyang'anya uhuru huo wanavyostahili adhabu zaidi; na kwa upande mwingine ndivyo waumini wenyewe wanavyopaswa kuilinda kwa bidii zaidi hazina hiyo isije ikatumiwa vibaya au kuvunjiwa heshima. Kwa maana hii mstari wa 13a unasimama kati ya hukumu dhidi ya watetezi wa tohara katika mstari wa 12 na wito kwa Wagalatia unaofuata. Unarudia tangazo la uhuru la mstari wa 1, na kulifanya kuwa msingi wa hukumu iliyotamkwa dhidi ya maadui wa uhuru na pia wa onyo linalotolewa kwa wenye uhuru huo. "Kwa maana mliitwa (mliitwa na Mungu kuingia katika ufalme wa Mwanawe) mpate uhuru—si utumwa wa sheria; wala, kwa upande mwingine, si ili mjiachie kufanya kila mnalotaka na kuzipa tamaa na mapenzi yenu nafasi ya kutawala—si uhuru uwe sababu ya kuufuata mwili."

segments.en: I. Here lies the danger of liberty, especially when conferred on a young, untrained nature, and in a newly emancipated community.
segments.sw: I. Hapa ndipo ilipo hatari ya uhuru, hasa unapotolewa kwa tabia changa, isiyofundishwa, na katika jumuiya iliyowekwa huru karibuni.

segments.en: Freedom is a priceless boon; but it is a grave responsibility. It has its temptations, as well as its joys and dignities. The Apostle has spoken at length of the latter: it is the former that he has now to urge. Keep your liberties, he seems to say; for Christ's sake and for truth's sake hold them fast, guard them well. You are God's regenerated sons. Never forego your high calling. God is on your side; and those who assail you shall feel the weight of His displeasure. Yes, "stand fast" in the liberty wherewith "Christ made you free." But take care how you employ your freedom; "only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh." This significant only turns the other side of the medal, and bids us read the legend on its reverse front. On the obverse we have found it written, "The Lord knoweth them that are His" (2 Tim. ii. 19; comp. Gal. iv. 6, 9). This is the side of privilege and of grace, the spiritual side of the Christian life. On the reverse it bears the motto, "Let every one that nameth the name of the Lord depart from iniquity." This is the second, the ethical side of our calling, the side of duty, to which we have now to turn.
segments.sw: Uhuru ni baraka isiyo na thamani ya kulinganishwa; lakini ni wajibu mzito. Una vishawishi vyake, kama vile ulivyo na furaha na heshima zake. Mtume amezungumza kwa kirefu kuhusu mambo hayo ya mwisho; sasa anapaswa kusisitiza yale ya kwanza. Dumisheni uhuru wenu, ni kana kwamba anasema; kwa ajili ya Kristo na kwa ajili ya kweli, ushikilieni kwa uthabiti, uulindeni vizuri. Ninyi ni wana wa Mungu mliozaliwa upya. Kamwe msiache wito wenu wa juu. Mungu yuko upande wenu; na wale wanaowashambulia watahisi uzito wa ghadhabu yake. Naam, "simameni" katika uhuru ambao "Kristo alituweka huru" nao. Lakini jihadharini jinsi mnavyoutumia uhuru wenu; "lakini uhuru wenu usiwe sababu ya kuufuata mwili." Neno hili muhimu lakini linageuza medali upande mwingine na kutuambia tusome maandishi yaliyo nyuma yake. Upande wa mbele tumeona yameandikwa maneno, "Bwana awajua walio wake" (2 Tim. ii. 19; linganisha Gal. iv. 6, 9). Huu ni upande wa haki ya pekee na wa neema, upande wa kiroho wa maisha ya Kikristo. Upande wa nyuma una kauli mbiu hii: "Kila alitajaye jina la Bwana na auache uovu." Huu ndio upande wa pili wa wito wetu, upande wa maadili, upande wa wajibu, ambao sasa tunapaswa kuugeukia.

segments.en: The man, or the nation that has won its freedom, has won but half the battle. It has conquered external foes; it has still to prevail over itself. And this is the harder task. Men clamour for liberty, when they mean licence; what they seek is the liberty of the flesh, not of the Spirit, freedom to indulge their lusts and to trample on the rights of others, the freedom of outlaws and brigands. The natural man defines freedom as the power to do as he likes; not the right of self-regulation, but the absence of regulation is what he desires. And this is just what the Spirit of God will never allow (ver. 17). When such a man has thrown off outward constraint and the dread of punishment, there is no inward law to take its place. It is his greed, his passion, his pride and ambition that call for freedom; not his conscience. And to all such libertarians our Saviour says, "He that committeth sin is the slave of sin." No tyrant is so vile, so insatiable as our own self-indulged sin. A pitiable triumph, for a man to have secured his religious liberty only to become the thrall of his vices!
segments.sw: Mtu, au taifa, lililopata uhuru wake limeshinda nusu tu ya vita. Limeshinda maadui wa nje; bado linapaswa kujishinda lenyewe. Na hiyo ndiyo kazi ngumu zaidi. Watu hupiga kelele wakidai uhuru, ilhali wanachomaanisha ni kujiachilia bila mipaka; wanachotafuta ni uhuru wa mwili, si wa Roho, uhuru wa kutosheleza tamaa zao na kukanyaga haki za wengine, uhuru wa wahalifu na wanyang'anyi. Mwanadamu wa asili hufafanua uhuru kuwa uwezo wa kufanya apendavyo; anachotaka si haki ya kujitawala mwenyewe, bali kutokuwapo kwa kanuni zozote. Na hili ndilo jambo ambalo Roho wa Mungu hataruhusu kamwe (mst. 17). Mtu wa namna hiyo anapokuwa amejivua vizuizi vya nje na hofu ya adhabu, hana sheria ya ndani ya kuchukua nafasi yake. Ni uchoyo wake, tamaa yake, kiburi chake na kutaka kwake makuu vinavyodai uhuru; si dhamiri yake. Na kwa wote wanaodai uhuru wa namna hiyo Mwokozi wetu anasema, "Kila atendaye dhambi ni mtumwa wa dhambi." Hakuna dhalimu mwovu na asiyeweza kushibishwa kama dhambi zetu wenyewe tunazozitosheleza. Ni ushindi wa kusikitisha kama nini, kwa mtu kupata uhuru wake wa kidini halafu akawa mtumwa wa maovu yake!

segments.en: It is possible that some men accepted the gospel under the delusion that it afforded a shelter for sin. The sensualist, deterred from his indulgences by fear of the Law, joined in Paul's campaign against it, imagining that Grace would give him larger freedom. If "where sin abounded grace did superabound," he would say in his heart, Why not sin the more, so that grace might have a greater victory? This is no fanciful inference. Hypocrisy has learned to wear the garb of evangelical zeal; and teachers of the gospel have not always guarded sufficiently against this shocking perversion. Even the man whose heart has been truly touched and changed by Divine grace, when the freshness of his first love to Christ has passed away and temptation renews its assaults, is liable to this deception. He may begin to think that sin is less perilous, since forgiveness was so easily obtained. He may presume that as a son of God, sealed by the Spirit of adoption, he will not be allowed to fall, even though he stumble. He is one of "God's elect"; what "shall separate him" from the Divine love in Christ? In this assurance he holds a talisman that secures his safety. What need to "watch and pray lest he enter into temptation," when the Lord is his keeper? He is God's enfranchised son; "all things are lawful" to him; "things present" as well as "things to come" are his in Christ. By such reasonings his liberty is turned into an occasion to the flesh. And men who before they boasted themselves sons of God were restrained by the spirit of bondage and fear, have found in this assurance the occasion, the "starting-point" (ἀφορμή) for a more shameless course of evil.
segments.sw: Inawezekana kwamba baadhi ya watu waliikubali injili kwa dhana potovu kwamba inawapa mahali pa kujificha ili waendelee kutenda dhambi. Mtu anayejitosa katika tamaa za mwili, ambaye hofu ya Sheria ilikuwa ikimzuia kujifurahisha nazo, alijiunga na kampeni ya Paulo dhidi ya Sheria akidhani kwamba Neema ingempa uhuru mpana zaidi. Ikiwa "dhambi ilipozidi, neema ilikuwa nyingi zaidi," angesema moyoni mwake, kwa nini nisitende dhambi zaidi ili neema ipate ushindi mkubwa zaidi? Hili si hitimisho la kubuniwa. Unafiki umejifunza kuvaa vazi la bidii kwa ajili ya injili; na walimu wa injili hawajajihadhari kila mara vya kutosha dhidi ya upotoshaji huu wa kushtua. Hata mtu ambaye moyo wake umeguswa kweli na kubadilishwa na neema ya Mungu anaweza kudanganywa hivyo, wakati uchangamfu wa upendo wake wa kwanza kwa Kristo unapopita na majaribu yanapoanza kumshambulia tena. Anaweza kuanza kufikiri kwamba dhambi haina hatari kubwa sana, kwa kuwa msamaha ulipatikana kwa urahisi. Anaweza kujikinai kwamba, akiwa mwana wa Mungu aliyetiwa muhuri na Roho wa kufanywa wana, hataruhusiwa kuanguka hata akijikwaa. Yeye ni mmoja wa "wateule wa Mungu"; ni nini "kitakachomtenga" na upendo wa Mungu katika Kristo? Katika uhakikisho huo anadhani ana hirizi inayomhakikishia usalama. Kuna haja gani ya "kukesha na kuomba asije akaingia majaribuni," wakati Bwana ndiye mlinzi wake? Yeye ni mwana wa Mungu aliyewekwa huru; "vitu vyote ni halali" kwake; "vilivyopo" pamoja na "vitakavyokuwapo" ni vyake katika Kristo. Kwa hoja za namna hiyo uhuru wake hugeuzwa kuwa sababu ya kuufuata mwili. Na watu ambao, kabla ya kujivunia kuwa wana wa Mungu, walizuiwa na roho ya utumwa na hofu, wamepata katika uhakikisho huo fursa, yaani "mahali pa kuanzia" (ἀφορμή), kwa mwenendo wa uovu usio na haya zaidi.

segments.en: In the view of Legalism, this is the natural outcome of Pauline teaching. From the first it has been charged with fostering lawlessness. In the Lutheran Reformation Rome pointed to the Antinomians, and moralists of our own day speak of "canting Evangelicals," just as the Judaists alleged the existence of immoral Paulinists, whose conduct, they declared, was the proper fruit of the preaching of emancipation from the Law. These, they would say to the Apostle, are your spiritual children; they do but carry your doctrine to its legitimate issue. This reproach the gospel has always had to bear; there have been those, alas, amongst its professors whose behaviour has given it plausibility. Sensualists will "turn the grace of our God into lasciviousness;" swine will trample under their feet the pure pearls of the gospel. But they are pure and precious none the less.
segments.sw: Kwa mtazamo wa ushikaji wa sheria, haya ndiyo matokeo ya kawaida ya mafundisho ya Paulo. Tangu mwanzo yameshtakiwa kwamba yanachochea uasi dhidi ya sheria. Wakati wa Matengenezo ya Kilutheri, Roma iliwaonyesha wale waliopinga sheria; na wataalamu wa maadili wa siku zetu husema kuhusu "wainjili wanaojifanya wacha Mungu," kama vile wafuasi wa Uyahudi walivyodai kwamba walikuwapo wafuasi wa Paulo wasio na maadili ambao mwenendo wao, kwa madai yao, ulikuwa tunda linalotarajiwa la mahubiri ya kuwekwa huru kutoka katika Sheria. Wangemwambia Mtume, hawa ndio watoto wako wa kiroho; wanaendeleza tu fundisho lako hadi kwenye matokeo yake halisi. Injili imekuwa ikibeba lawama hii daima; kwa masikitiko, miongoni mwa wanaoikiri kumekuwako wale ambao mwenendo wao umeifanya lawama hiyo ionekane kuwa ya kweli. Wanaojitosa katika tamaa "huigeuza neema ya Mungu wetu kuwa ufisadi"; nguruwe watayakanyaga kwa miguu yao lulu safi za injili. Lakini lulu hizo hubaki safi na za thamani.

segments.en: This possibility is, however, a reason for the utmost watchfulness in those who are stewards in the administration of the gospel. They must be careful, like Paul, to make it abundantly clear that they "establish" and do not "make void law through faith" (Rom. iii. 31). There is an evangelical Ethics, as well as an evangelical Dogmatics. The ethics of the Gospel have been too little studied and applied. Hence much of the confessed failure of evangelical Churches in preserving and building up the converts that they win.
segments.sw: Hata hivyo, uwezekano huo ni sababu ya kukesha kwa uangalifu mkubwa kwa wale walio mawakili katika huduma ya injili. Kama Paulo, wanapaswa kuhakikisha kwamba inaeleweka wazi kabisa kuwa wanaithibitisha sheria, wala "hawaibatilishi sheria kwa imani" (Rum. iii. 31). Kuna maadili ya kiinjili, kama vile kulivyo na mfumo wa mafundisho ya kiinjili. Maadili ya Injili yamejifunzwa na kutumiwa kwa kiwango kidogo mno. Hapo ndipo inapotokana sehemu kubwa ya kushindwa kunakokiriwa na makanisa ya kiinjili katika kuwatunza na kuwajenga waongofu wanaowapata.

segments.en: II. Faith in Christ gives in truth a new efficacy to the moral law. For it works through love; and love fulfils all laws in one (vv. 13b, 14). Where faith has this operation, liberty is safe; not otherwise. Love's slaves are the true freemen.
segments.sw: II. Imani katika Kristo kwa kweli huipa sheria ya maadili nguvu mpya ya kutenda kazi. Kwa maana imani hutenda kazi kwa upendo; na upendo hutimiza sheria zote katika moja (mist. 13b, 14). Pale imani inapotenda kazi namna hii, uhuru huwa salama; si vinginevyo. Watumwa wa upendo ndio watu walio huru kweli.

segments.en: The legalist practically takes the same view of human nature as the sensualist. He knows nothing of "the desire of the Spirit" arrayed against that of the flesh (ver. 17), nothing of the mastery over the heart that belongs to the love of Christ. In his analysis the soul consists of so many desires, each blindly seeking its own gratification, which must be drilled into order under external pressure, by an intelligent application of law. Modern Utilitarians agree with the ancient Judaists in their ethical philosophy. Fear of punishment, hope of reward, the influence of the social environment--these are, as they hold, the factors which create character and shape our moral being. "Pain and pleasure," they tell us, "are the masters of human life." Without the faith that man is the child of God, formed in His image, we are practically shut up to this suicidal theory of morals. Suicidal we say, for it robs our spiritual being of everything distinctive in it, of all that raises the moral above the natural; it makes duty and personality illusions.
segments.sw: Mshikaji wa sheria kwa vitendo ana mtazamo uleule wa asili ya mwanadamu kama mtu anayejitosa katika tamaa za mwili. Hajui lolote kuhusu "tamaa ya Roho" inayopinga ile ya mwili (mst. 17), wala kuhusu utawala juu ya moyo ambao ni wa upendo wa Kristo. Katika uchanganuzi wake, nafsi inajumuisha tamaa nyingi, kila moja ikitafuta bila kuona kutoshelezwa kwake yenyewe; tamaa hizo zinapaswa kufundishwa kuwa na mpangilio kwa shinikizo la nje, kwa kutumia sheria kwa akili. Wafuasi wa kisasa wa falsafa inayopima maadili kwa manufaa yake (Utilitarians) wanakubaliana na wafuasi wa kale wa Uyahudi katika falsafa yao ya maadili. Hofu ya adhabu, tumaini la thawabu, ushawishi wa mazingira ya kijamii—haya ndiyo mambo ambayo, kwa mtazamo wao, huunda tabia na kujenga hali yetu ya kimaadili. Wanatuambia kwamba "maumivu na raha ndio watawala wa maisha ya mwanadamu." Bila imani kwamba mwanadamu ni mtoto wa Mungu aliyeumbwa kwa mfano wake, kwa vitendo hatuna budi kukubali nadharia hii ya maadili inayojiharibu yenyewe. Inayojiharibu yenyewe, twasema, kwa sababu inatunyang'anya kila jambo la pekee katika utu wetu wa kiroho, yote yanayoinua maadili juu ya asili; inafanya wajibu na utu kuwa mambo ya kudhaniwa tu.

segments.en: Judaism is a proof that this scheme of life is impracticable. For the Pharisaic system which produced such deplorable moral results, was an experiment in external ethics. It was in fact the application of a highly developed and elaborate traditional code of law, enforced by the strongest outward sanctions, without personal loyalty to the Divine Lawgiver. In the national conscience of the Jews this was wanting. Their faith in God, as the Epistle of James declares, was a "dead" faith, a bundle of abstract notions. Loyalty is true law-keeping. And loyalty springs from the personal relationship of the subject and the law-making power. This nexus Christian sonship supplies, in its purest and most exalted form. When I see in the Lawgiver my Almighty Father, when the law has become incarnate in the person of my Saviour, my heart's King and Lord, it wears a changed aspect. "His commandments are not grievous." Duty, required by Him, is honour and delight. No abstract law, no "stream of tendency" can command the homage or awaken the moral energy that is inspired by "the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord."
segments.sw: Uyahudi unathibitisha kwamba mpangilio huu wa maisha hauwezekani kutekelezwa. Kwa maana mfumo wa Mafarisayo uliozaa matokeo mabaya namna hiyo ya kimaadili ulikuwa jaribio la maadili yanayotegemea mambo ya nje. Kwa kweli ulikuwa utekelezaji wa kanuni ya sheria za mapokeo iliyoendelezwa sana na yenye maelezo mengi, ikisimamiwa kwa vitisho na ahadi kali zaidi za nje, bila uaminifu wa kibinafsi kwa Mtoa Sheria wa kimungu. Huo ndio uaminifu uliokosekana katika dhamiri ya taifa la Wayahudi. Imani yao katika Mungu, kama Waraka wa Yakobo unavyotangaza, ilikuwa imani "iliyokufa," mkusanyiko wa mawazo ya kinadharia. Uaminifu ndio ushikaji wa kweli wa sheria. Na uaminifu unatokana na uhusiano wa kibinafsi kati ya aliye chini ya mamlaka na mwenye mamlaka ya kutunga sheria. Huo ndio uhusiano ambao hali ya Mkristo kuwa mwana wa Mungu huleta, katika hali yake safi na ya juu kabisa. Ninapomwona Baba yangu Mwenyezi ndani ya Mtoa Sheria, sheria inapofanyika mwili katika nafsi ya Mwokozi wangu, Mfalme na Bwana wa moyo wangu, sheria hiyo ina sura tofauti. "Amri zake si nzito." Wajibu anaoutaka ni heshima na furaha. Hakuna sheria ya kinadharia, hakuna "mkondo wa mwelekeo," unaoweza kudai heshima au kuamsha nguvu za kimaadili zinazoamshwa na "upendo wa Mungu ulio katika Kristo Yesu Bwana wetu."

segments.en: Here the Apostle traverses antinomian deductions from his doctrine of liberty. In the Epistle to the Romans (ch. vi.) he deals at length with the theoretical objection to his teaching on this subject. He shows there that salvation by faith, rightly understood and experienced, renders continuance in sin impossible. For faith in Christ is in effect the union of the soul with Christ, first in His death, and then consequently in His risen life, wherein He lives only "to God." Nay, Christ Himself lives in the believing man (Gal. ii. 20). Instead of our sinning "because we are not under the law, but under grace," this is precisely the reason why we need not and must not sin. Faith joins us to the risen Christ, whose life we share--so Paul argues--and we should not sin any more than He. Here, from the practical standpoint, he lays it down that faith works by love; and love casts out sin, for it unites all laws in itself. Faith links us to Christ in heaven (Romans); faith fills us with His love on earth (Galatians). So love, marked out in ver. 6 as the energy of faith, now serves as the guard of liberty. Neither legalist nor law-breaker understands the meaning of faith in Christ.
segments.sw: Hapa Mtume anapinga mahitimisho ya kupinga sheria yanayotolewa kutokana na fundisho lake la uhuru. Katika Waraka kwa Warumi (sura ya vi.) anashughulikia kwa kirefu pingamizi la kinadharia dhidi ya mafundisho yake kuhusu jambo hili. Humo anaonyesha kwamba wokovu kwa imani, unapoeleweka na kushuhudiwa kwa usahihi, hufanya kuendelea katika dhambi kuwa jambo lisilowezekana. Kwa maana imani katika Kristo kwa hakika ni kuunganishwa kwa nafsi na Kristo, kwanza katika kifo chake, na kwa hiyo katika maisha yake ya ufufuo, ambamo anaishi kwa ajili ya "Mungu" peke yake. Zaidi ya hayo, Kristo mwenyewe anaishi ndani ya mtu anayeamini (Gal. ii. 20). Badala ya sisi kutenda dhambi "kwa sababu hatuwi chini ya sheria bali chini ya neema," hiyo ndiyo hasa sababu inayotufanya tusiwe na haja ya kutenda dhambi wala tusipaswe kuitenda. Imani inatuunganisha na Kristo aliyefufuka, ambaye maisha yake tunayashiriki—hivyo ndivyo Paulo anavyojenga hoja yake—na hatupaswi kutenda dhambi kama vile yeye asivyotenda dhambi. Hapa, kwa mtazamo wa vitendo, anaweka kanuni kwamba imani hutenda kazi kwa upendo; na upendo huiondoa dhambi, kwa maana unaunganisha sheria zote ndani yake. Imani inatuunganisha na Kristo mbinguni (Warumi); imani inatujaza upendo wake duniani (Wagalatia). Kwa hiyo upendo, uliotajwa katika mstari wa 6 kuwa nguvu inayoiendesha imani, sasa unatumika kuwa mlinzi wa uhuru. Wala mshikaji wa sheria wala mvunja sheria haelewi maana ya imani katika Kristo.

segments.en: At this point Paul throws in one of his bold paradoxes. He has been contending all through the Epistle for freedom, bidding his readers scorn the legal yoke, breathing into them his own contempt for the pettiness of Judaistic ceremonial. But now he turns round suddenly and bids them be slaves: "but let love," he says, "make you bondmen to each other" (ver. 13). Instead of breaking bonds, he seeks to create stronger bonds, stronger because dearer. Paul preaches no gospel of individualism, of egotistic salvation-seeking. The self-sacrifice of Christ becomes in turn a principle of sacrifice in those who receive it. Paul's own ideal is, to be "conformed to His death" (Phil. iii. 10). There is nothing anarchic or self-asserting in his plea for freedom. He opposes the law of Pharisaic externalism in the interests of the law of Christian love. The yoke of Judaism must be broken, its bonds cast aside, in order to give free play to "the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus." Faith transfers authority from flesh to spirit, giving it a surer seat, a more effective, and in reality more lawful command over man's nature. It restores the normal equipoise of the soul. Now the Divine law is written on "the tablets of the heart"; and this makes it far more sovereign than when engraved on the stone slabs of Sinai. Love and law for the believer in Christ are fused into one. In this union law loses nothing of its holy severity; and love nothing of its tenderness. United they constitute the Christian sense of duty, whose sternest exactions are enforced by gratitude and devotion.
segments.sw: Katika hatua hii Paulo anatoa mojawapo ya kauli zake jasiri zinazoonekana kujipinga. Katika Waraka wote amekuwa akiutetea uhuru, akiwaambia wasomaji wake waidharau nira ya sheria, akiwatia moyo wa dharau yake mwenyewe kwa udogo wa mambo ya sherehe za Kiyahudi. Lakini sasa anageuka ghafla na kuwaambia wawe watumwa: "lakini," anasema, "upendo uwafanye kuwa watumwa ninyi kwa ninyi" (mst. 13). Badala ya kuvunja vifungo, anataka kuunda vifungo vyenye nguvu zaidi, vyenye nguvu zaidi kwa sababu vinapendwa zaidi. Paulo hahubiri injili ya ubinafsi, ya kutafuta wokovu kwa kujifikiria mwenyewe tu. Kujitoa dhabihu kwa Kristo kunakuwa, kwa upande wake, kanuni ya kujitoa ndani ya wale wanaokipokea. Lengo la Paulo mwenyewe ni "kufananishwa na kufa kwake" (Flp. iii. 10). Hakuna jambo la kuleta vurugu bila utawala wala la kujitukuza katika utetezi wake wa uhuru. Anapinga sheria ya Mafarisayo ya mambo ya nje kwa ajili ya sheria ya upendo wa Kikristo. Nira ya Uyahudi lazima ivunjwe, vifungo vyake vitupwe mbali, ili "sheria ya Roho wa uzima ule ulio katika Kristo Yesu" iweze kufanya kazi kwa uhuru. Imani inahamisha mamlaka kutoka kwa mwili kwenda kwa roho, ikiipa msingi imara zaidi na utawala wenye nguvu zaidi na kwa kweli wenye haki zaidi juu ya asili ya mwanadamu. Inarejesha usawaziko wa kawaida wa nafsi. Sasa sheria ya Mungu imeandikwa juu ya "mbao za moyo"; na hilo huifanya iwe na mamlaka makubwa zaidi kuliko ilipokuwa imechongwa juu ya mbao za mawe za Sinai. Kwa mwamini katika Kristo, upendo na sheria huungana kuwa kitu kimoja. Katika muungano huu sheria haipotezi chochote cha ukali wake mtakatifu, wala upendo haupotezi chochote cha huruma yake. Zikiunganishwa huunda hisia ya Kikristo ya wajibu, ambao madai yake makali zaidi hutimizwa kwa shukrani na kujitoa.

segments.en: And love is ever conqueror. To it toil and endurance that mock the achievement of other powers, are a light thing. Needing neither bribe nor threat, love labours, waits, braves a thousand dangers, keeps the hands busy, the eye keen and watchful, the feet running to and fro untired through the longest day. There is no industry, no ingenuity like that of love. Love makes the mother the slave of the babe at her breast, and wins from the friend for his friend service that no compulsion could exact, rendered in pure gladness and free-will. Its power alone calls forth what is best and strongest in us all. Love is mightier than death. In Jesus Christ, love has "laid down life for its friends"; the fulness of life has encountered and overcome the uttermost of death. Love esteems it bondage to be prevented, liberty only to be allowed to serve.
segments.sw: Na upendo hushinda daima. Kwake, kazi ngumu na uvumilivu unaofanya mafanikio ya nguvu nyingine yaonekane kuwa madogo ni jambo jepesi. Bila kuhitaji rushwa wala vitisho, upendo hufanya kazi, hungoja, hukabili hatari elfu moja, hufanya mikono iwe na shughuli, jicho liwe makini na lenye kukesha, na miguu ikimbie huku na huko bila kuchoka hata katika siku ndefu zaidi. Hakuna bidii, hakuna ubunifu unaolingana na ule wa upendo. Upendo humfanya mama kuwa mtumwa wa mtoto anayenyonya kifuani mwake, na humpatia rafiki huduma kutoka kwa rafiki yake ambayo hakuna shuruti inayoweza kuidai, huduma inayotolewa kwa furaha safi na hiari. Nguvu yake peke yake huibua yaliyo bora na yenye nguvu zaidi ndani yetu sote. Upendo una nguvu kuliko mauti. Katika Yesu Kristo, upendo "umetoa uhai kwa ajili ya rafiki zake"; utimilifu wa uzima umekutana na kushinda ukomo wa mauti. Upendo huona kuzuiwa kutumikia kuwa utumwa, na uhuru kuwa kuruhusiwa kutumikia.

segments.en: Without love, freedom is an empty boon. It brings no ease, no joy of heart. It is objectless and listless. Bereft of faith and love, though possessing the most perfect independence, the soul drifts along like a ship rudderless and masterless, with neither haven nor horizon. Wordsworth, in his Ode to Duty, has finely expressed the weariness that comes of such liberty, unguided by an inward law and a Divine ideal:
segments.sw: Bila upendo, uhuru ni baraka tupu. Hauleti raha wala furaha ya moyo. Hauna lengo wala hamasa. Ikiwa imenyang'anywa imani na upendo, hata ikiwa na uhuru kamili kabisa, nafsi huelea kama meli isiyo na usukani wala nahodha, isiyo na bandari wala upeo wa macho. Wordsworth, katika shairi lake Ode to Duty, ameeleza vizuri uchovu unaotokana na uhuru wa namna hiyo usioongozwa na sheria ya ndani na lengo la kimungu:

segments.en: "Me this unchartered freedom tires; I feel the weight of chance desires: My hopes no more must change their name; I long for a repose that ever is the same."
segments.sw: "Uhuru huu usio na mwongozo unanichosha; Nahisi uzito wa tamaa zinazojitokeza kwa nasibu: Matumaini yangu yasibadilishe tena majina yao; Natamani pumziko lililo lilelile daima."

segments.en: But on the other hand,
segments.sw: Lakini kwa upande mwingine,

segments.en: "Serene will be our days and bright, And happy will our nature be, When love is an unerring light, And joy its own security."
segments.sw: "Siku zetu zitakuwa tulivu na zenye mwanga, Na asili yetu itakuwa na furaha, Wakati upendo utakapokuwa nuru isiyopoteza njia, Na furaha ikiwa dhamana ya usalama wake yenyewe."

segments.en: This "royal law" (Jam. ii. 8) blends with its sovereignty of power the charm of simplicity. "The whole law," says the Apostle, "hath been fulfilled in one word--LOVE" (ver. 14). The Master said, "I came not to destroy the law, but to fulfil." The key to His fulfilment was given in the declaration of the twofold command of love to God and to our neighbour. "On these two hang all the law and the prophets." Hence the Apostle's phrase, hath been fulfilled. This unification of the moral code is accomplished. Christ's life and death have given to this truth full expression and universal currency. Love's fulfilment of law stands before us a positive attainment, an incontestable fact. Paul does not speak here, as in Rom. xiii. 9, of the comprehending, the "summing up" of all laws in one; but of the bringing of law to its completion, its realisation and consummation in the love of Christ. "O how I love Thy law," said the purer spirit of the Old Testament. "Thy love is my law," says the true spirit of the New.
segments.sw: "Sheria hii ya kifalme" (Yak. ii. 8) inaunganisha ukuu wa mamlaka yake na mvuto wa urahisi wake. "Torati yote," asema Mtume, "imetimilika katika neno moja—UPENDO" (mst. 14). Bwana alisema, "Sikuja kuitangua, bali kuitimiliza." Ufunguo wa kuitimiliza kwake ulitolewa katika tangazo la amri mbili za kumpenda Mungu na kumpenda jirani yetu. "Katika amri hizi mbili hutegemea torati yote na manabii." Ndiyo maana Mtume anatumia maneno imetimilika. Kuunganishwa huku kwa kanuni za maadili kumekamilishwa. Maisha na kifo cha Kristo yameupa ukweli huu udhihirisho kamili na kuufanya ujulikane kwa wote. Utimilifu wa sheria kwa njia ya upendo unasimama mbele yetu kama jambo lililofikiwa kweli, ukweli usioweza kupingwa. Paulo hapa hasemi, kama katika Rum. xiii. 9, juu ya kuzijumuisha, yaani "kuzifupisha," sheria zote katika moja; bali juu ya kuifikisha sheria kwenye ukamilifu wake, kuifanya iwe halisi na kutimia kwake katika upendo wa Kristo. "Naipenda sheria yako mno ajabu," alisema mtu mwenye roho safi zaidi ya Agano la Kale. "Upendo wako ndio sheria yangu," yasema roho ya kweli ya Agano Jipya.

segments.en: It is remarkable that this supreme principle of Christian ethics is first enunciated in the most legal part of the Old Testament. Leviticus is the Book of the Priestly Legislation. It is chiefly occupied with ceremonial and civil regulations. Yet in the midst of the legal minutiæ is set this sublime and simple rule, than which Jesus Christ could prescribe nothing more Divine: Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself (Levit. xix. 18). This sentence is the conclusion of a series of directions (vv. 9-18) forbidding unneighbourly conduct, each of them sealed with the declaration, "I am Jehovah." This brief code of brotherly love breathes a truly Christian spirit; it is a beautiful expression of "the law of kindness" that is on the lips and in the heart of the child of God. We find in the law-book of Mosaism, side by side with elaborate rules of sacrificial ritual and the homeliest details touching the life of a rude agricultural people, conceptions of God and of duty of surpassing loftiness and purity, such as meet us in the religion of no other ancient nation.
segments.sw: Ni jambo la kushangaza kwamba kanuni hii kuu ya maadili ya Kikristo inatamkwa kwanza katika sehemu ya Agano la Kale iliyojaa sheria zaidi. Mambo ya Walawi ni Kitabu cha Sheria za Makuhani. Kinashughulika hasa na kanuni za sherehe za kidini na za kiraia. Hata hivyo, katikati ya maelezo madogo madogo ya sheria, imewekwa kanuni hii tukufu na rahisi, ambayo Yesu Kristo mwenyewe hangeweza kuweka nyingine iliyo ya kimungu zaidi: Umpende jirani yako kama nafsi yako (Law. xix. 18). Sentensi hii ni hitimisho la mfululizo wa maagizo (mist. 9-18) yanayokataza mwenendo usiofaa kwa jirani, kila moja likitiwa muhuri kwa tangazo, "Mimi ndimi Bwana." Kanuni hii fupi ya upendo wa kindugu inaonyesha roho ya Kikristo kweli; ni udhihirisho mzuri wa "sheria ya fadhili" iliyo midomoni na moyoni mwa mtoto wa Mungu. Katika kitabu cha sheria za Musa, kando ya kanuni nyingi za ibada ya dhabihu na maelezo ya kawaida kabisa yanayohusu maisha ya jamii ya wakulima wasio na maendeleo makubwa, tunapata mawazo kuhusu Mungu na wajibu yaliyo ya hali ya juu sana na safi sana, ambayo hatuyapati katika dini ya taifa lingine lolote la kale.

segments.en: The law, therefore, opposed and cast out in the name of faith, is brought in again under the shield of love. "If ye love Me," said Jesus, "keep my commandments." Love reconciles law and faith. Law by itself can but prohibit this and that injury to one's neighbour, when they are likely to arise. Love excludes the doing of any injury; it "worketh no ill to its neighbour, therefore love is the fulfilling of the law" (Rom. xiii. 10). That which law restrains or condemns after the fact, love renders impossible beforehand. It is not content with the negative prevention of wrong; it "overcomes" and displaces "evil with good."
segments.sw: Kwa hiyo sheria, iliyopingwa na kutupwa nje kwa jina la imani, inarudishwa chini ya ngao ya upendo. "Mkinipenda," Yesu alisema, "mtazishika amri zangu." Upendo hupatanisha sheria na imani. Sheria yenyewe inaweza tu kukataza madhara haya au yale kwa jirani, wakati yanapoweza kutokea. Upendo huondoa kabisa uwezekano wa kutenda madhara yoyote; "pendo halimfanyii jirani neno baya; basi pendo ndilo utimilifu wa sheria" (Rum. xiii. 10). Kile ambacho sheria hukizuia au kukihukumu baada ya kutendwa, upendo hukifanya kisiwezekane tangu mwanzo. Hauridhiki na kuzuia uovu tu; "huushinda" na kuondoa "ubaya kwa wema."

segments.en: "What law could not do," with all its multiplied enactments and redoubled threats, faith "working by love" has accomplished at a stroke. "The righteousness of the law is fulfilled in those who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit" (Rom. viii. 3, 4). Gentile Christians have been raised to the level of a righteousness "exceeding that of scribes and pharisees" (Matt. v. 20). The flesh which defied law's terrors and evaded its control, is subdued by the love of Christ. Law created the need of salvation; it defined its conditions and the direction which it must take. But there its power ceased. It could not change the sinful heart. It supplied no motive adequate to secure obedience. The moralist errs in substituting duty for love, works for faith. He would make the rule furnish the motive, the path supply strength to walk in it. The distinction of the gospel is that it is "the power of God unto salvation," while the law is "weak through the flesh."
segments.sw: "Jambo lile lisilowezekana kwa sheria," pamoja na kanuni zake nyingi na vitisho vyake vilivyoongezwa, imani "itendayo kazi kwa upendo" imelitimiza mara moja. "Maagizo ya torati yatimizwe ndani yetu sisi, tusioenenda kwa kufuata mambo ya mwili, bali mambo ya roho" (Rum. viii. 3, 4). Wakristo wa Mataifa wameinuliwa kufikia kiwango cha haki "inayozidi hiyo haki ya waandishi na Mafarisayo" (Mt. v. 20). Mwili uliokaidi vitisho vya sheria na kukwepa utawala wake unatiishwa kwa upendo wa Kristo. Sheria ilionyesha uhitaji wa wokovu; ilifafanua masharti yake na mwelekeo ambao wokovu huo ulipaswa kuchukua. Lakini hapo ndipo uwezo wake ulipoishia. Haikuweza kuubadilisha moyo wenye dhambi. Haikutoa msukumo wa kutosha kuhakikisha utii. Mtaalamu wa maadili hukosea kwa kuweka wajibu badala ya upendo, matendo badala ya imani. Angeifanya kanuni yenyewe kutoa msukumo, na njia yenyewe kutoa nguvu za kuipitia. Sifa ya pekee ya injili ni kwamba ni "uweza wa Mungu uuletao wokovu," wakati sheria ni "dhaifu kwa sababu ya mwili."

segments.en: Paul does not therefore override the law in the interest of faith. Quite the contrary, he establishes, he magnifies it. His theology rests on the idea of Righteousness, which is strictly a legal conception. But he puts the law in its proper place. He secures for it the alliance of love. The legalist, desiring to exalt law, in reality stultifies it. Striving to make it omnipotent, he makes it impotent. In the Apostle's teaching, law is the rule, faith the spring of action. Law marks the path, love gives the will and power to follow it. Who then are the truest friends of law--Legalists or Paulinists, moralists or evangelicals?
segments.sw: Kwa hiyo Paulo haifutilii mbali sheria kwa ajili ya imani. Kinyume chake kabisa, anaithibitisha na kuitukuza. Teolojia yake inategemea wazo la Haki, ambalo kwa maana halisi ni dhana ya kisheria. Lakini anaiweka sheria mahali pake panapostahili. Anaipatia ushirikiano wa upendo. Mshikaji wa sheria, akitaka kuitukuza sheria, kwa kweli huifanya isiwe na maana. Akijaribu kuifanya iwe na uwezo wote, huifanya isiwe na uwezo. Katika mafundisho ya Mtume, sheria ni kanuni, imani ni chanzo cha matendo. Sheria huonyesha njia, upendo hutoa nia na nguvu za kuifuata. Basi, ni akina nani walio marafiki wa kweli zaidi wa sheria—washikaji wa sheria au wafuasi wa Paulo, wataalamu wa maadili au wainjili?

segments.en: III. Alas, the Galatians at the present moment afford a spectacle far different from the ideal which Paul has drawn. Instead of "serving each other in love," they are "biting and devouring one another." The Church is in danger of being "consumed" by their jealousies and quarrels (ver. 15).
segments.sw: III. Ole, kwa wakati huu Wagalatia wanaonyesha hali iliyo tofauti sana na lengo ambalo Paulo amelieleza. Badala ya "kutumikiana kwa upendo," wao "wanaumana na kulana." Kanisa liko katika hatari ya "kuangamizwa" na wivu wao na magomvi yao (mst. 15).

segments.en: These Asiatic Gauls were men of a warm temperament, quick to resent wrong and prone to imagine it. The dissensions excited by the Judaic controversy had excited their combative temper to an unusual degree. "Biting" describes the wounding and exasperating effect of the manner in which their contentions were carried on; "devour" warns them of its destructiveness. Taunts were hurled across the field of debate; vituperation supplied the lack of argument. Differences of opinion engendered private feuds and rankling injuries. In Corinth the spirit of discord had taken a factious form. It arrayed men in conflicting parties, with their distinctive watchwords and badges and sectional platforms. In these Churches it bore fruit in personal affronts and quarrels, in an angry, vindictive temper, which spread through the Galatian societies and broke out in every possible form of contention (v. 20). If this state of things continued, the Churches of Galatia would cease to exist. Their liberty would end in complete disintegration.
segments.sw: Watu hawa wa Kigauli wa Asia walikuwa watu wenye hisia kali, wepesi wa kuchukizwa na kosa na wenye mwelekeo wa kudhani kwamba wamekosewa. Mifarakano iliyochochewa na mabishano kuhusu Uyahudi ilikuwa imeichochea tabia yao ya kupenda mapambano kwa kiwango kisicho cha kawaida. "Kuuma" kunaeleza matokeo ya kujeruhi na kukasirisha ya jinsi walivyoendesha mabishano yao; "kulana" kunawaonya kuhusu uharibifu wake. Dhihaka zilirushwa huku na huku katika uwanja wa mjadala; matusi yalichukua nafasi ya hoja zilizokosekana. Tofauti za maoni zilizaa uadui wa kibinafsi na majeraha yaliyoendelea kuumiza. Huko Korintho roho ya mifarakano ilikuwa imechukua umbo la migawanyiko ya makundi. Iliwapanga watu katika vyama vilivyopingana, vikiwa na kauli mbiu, alama na misimamo ya kila kundi. Katika makanisa haya roho hiyo ilizaa matusi ya kibinafsi na magomvi, hasira na tabia ya kulipiza kisasi, iliyoenea katika jumuiya za Galatia na kujitokeza katika kila namna ya ugomvi (v. 20). Hali hii ikiendelea, makanisa ya Galatia yangekoma kuwapo. Uhuru wao ungeishia katika kusambaratika kabisa.

segments.en: Like some other communities, the Galatian Christians were oscillating between despotism and anarchy; they had not attained the equilibrium of a sober, ordered liberty, the freedom of a manly self-control. They had not sufficient respect either for their own or for each other's rights. Some men must be bridled or they will "bite;" they must wear the yoke or they run wild. They are incapable of being a law unto themselves. They have not faith enough to make them steadfast, nor love enough to be an inward guide, nor the Spirit of God in measure sufficient to overcome the vanity and self-indulgence of the flesh. But the Apostle still hopes to see his Galatian disciples worthy of their calling as sons of God. He points out to them the narrow but sure path that leads between the desert of legalism on the one hand, and the gulf of anarchy and licence on the other.
segments.sw: Kama jumuiya nyingine, Wakristo wa Galatia walikuwa wakiyumbayumba kati ya udhalimu na vurugu zisizo na utawala; hawakuwa wamefikia usawaziko wa uhuru wenye kiasi na mpangilio, uhuru wa kujitawala kwa ukomavu. Hawakuziheshimu vya kutosha haki zao wenyewe wala za wenzao. Baadhi ya watu lazima wazuiwe kwa lijamu la sivyo "watauma"; lazima wavae nira la sivyo watakwenda bila kujizuia. Hawana uwezo wa kuwa sheria kwa nafsi zao wenyewe. Hawana imani ya kutosha kuwafanya wawe thabiti, wala upendo wa kutosha kuwa mwongozo wa ndani, wala Roho wa Mungu kwa kiwango cha kutosha kushinda ubatili na kujifurahisha kwa mwili. Lakini Mtume bado anatumaini kuwaona wanafunzi wake wa Galatia wakiishi kwa kustahili wito wao kuwa wana wa Mungu. Anawaonyesha njia nyembamba lakini salama inayopita kati ya jangwa la ushikaji wa sheria upande mmoja, na shimo la vurugu zisizo na utawala na kujiachilia bila mipaka upande mwingine.

segments.en: The problem of the nature and conditions of Christian liberty occupies the Apostle's mind in different ways in all the letters of this period. The young Churches of the Gentiles were in the gravest peril. They had come out of Egypt to enter the Promised Land, the heritage of the sons of God. The Judaists sought to turn them aside into the Sinaitic wilderness of Mosaism; while their old habits and associations powerfully tended to draw them back into heathen immorality. Legalism and licence were the Scylla and Charybdis on either hand, between which it needed the most firm and skilful pilotage to steer the bark of the Church. The helm of the vessel is in Paul's hands. And, through the grace of God, he did not fail in his task. It is in the love of Christ that the Apostle found his guiding light. "Love," he has written, "never faileth."
segments.sw: Tatizo la asili na masharti ya uhuru wa Kikristo linashughulisha mawazo ya Mtume kwa njia mbalimbali katika nyaraka zote za kipindi hiki. Makanisa machanga ya Mataifa yalikuwa katika hatari kubwa kabisa. Yalikuwa yametoka Misri ili kuingia katika Nchi ya Ahadi, urithi wa wana wa Mungu. Wafuasi wa Uyahudi walitaka kuyageuza yaingie katika jangwa la Sinai la mfumo wa Musa; wakati huohuo desturi zao za kale na mahusiano yao ya zamani yalielekea kwa nguvu kuwarudisha kwenye mwenendo mpotovu wa kipagani. Ushikaji wa sheria na kujiachilia bila mipaka vilikuwa kama Scylla na Charybdis, hatari za kila upande, ambazo zilihitaji ustadi na uthabiti mkubwa wa kuiongoza meli ya Kanisa ipite katikati yake. Usukani wa meli hiyo uko mikononi mwa Paulo. Na kwa neema ya Mungu hakushindwa katika kazi yake. Mtume alipata nuru iliyomwongoza katika upendo wa Kristo. Ameandika kwamba "upendo haupungui neno wakati wo wote."

segments.en: Love is the handmaid of faith, and the firstborn fruit of the Spirit of Christ (vv. 6, 22). Blending with the law, love refashions it, changing it into its own image. Thus moulded and transfigured, law is no longer an exterior yoke, a system of restraint and penalty; it becomes an inner, sweet constraint. Upon the child of God it acts as an organic and formative energy, the principle of his regenerated being, which charges with its renovating influence all the springs of life. Evil is met no longer by a merely outward opposition, but by a repugnance proceeding from within. "The Spirit lusteth against the flesh" (v. 17). The law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus becomes the law of the man's new nature. God known and loved in Christ is the central object of his life. Within the Divine kingdom so created, the realm of love and of the Spirit, the soul henceforth dwells; and under that kingdom it places for itself all other souls, loved like itself in Christ.
segments.sw: Upendo ni mtumishi wa imani, na tunda la kwanza la Roho wa Kristo (mist. 6, 22). Ukiungana na sheria, upendo huiunda upya, ukiibadilisha iwe kwa mfano wake wenyewe. Ikiwa imeumbwa na kubadilishwa namna hiyo, sheria si tena nira ya nje, mfumo wa vizuizi na adhabu; inakuwa msukumo wa ndani wenye utamu. Kwa mtoto wa Mungu hutenda kazi kama nguvu ya uhai inayomjenga, kanuni ya utu wake uliozaliwa upya, ambayo hujaza chemchemi zote za maisha kwa ushawishi wake wa kufanya upya. Uovu haukabiliwi tena na upinzani wa nje tu, bali na chukizo linalotoka ndani. "Roho hutamani ukishindana na mwili" (v. 17). Sheria ya Roho wa uzima ulio katika Kristo Yesu inakuwa sheria ya asili mpya ya mwanadamu. Mungu anayejulikana na kupendwa katika Kristo ndiye kitovu cha maisha yake. Ndani ya ufalme wa Mungu ulioundwa hivyo, eneo la upendo na la Roho, nafsi hukaa tangu wakati huo; na chini ya ufalme huo inaziweka nafsi nyingine zote, ikizipenda kama inavyojipenda yenyewe katika Kristo.
